result.summary: Backports PR #36869 to the 30.x maintenance branch alongside release note updates. The change removes private access specifiers from dummy STL node helper structs in memusage, making the fields public so Clang 24 does not emit unused private field warnings.
result.problem: Compiling with newer versions of Clang (Clang 24) warns on unused private fields in STL helper structures whose layouts exist only for sizeof memory accounting calculations.
evidence: Commit 2030dbcb6c: 'Since llvm/llvm-project#237374, Clang 24 diagnoses these fields with -Wunused-private-field.'
result.scope_notes: Backport PR targeting the 30.x release branch.
result.card: This draft pull request backports PR #36869 to the 30.x maintenance branch and updates 30.x release notes. It drops private access specifiers on dummy STL layout helper structs used for memory estimation in memusage, preventing -Wunused-private-field compiler warnings on Clang 24. The change preserves struct layout and sizing while resolving compiler diagnostics.

risk.why: The patch only changes access specifiers on unused struct fields used for sizeof estimates, posing negligible risk to runtime behavior.
